top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature experimental achievement that opened controlled access to strongly interacting fermionic matter and enabled sustained study of the BEC–BCS crossover. Its significance is fundamental and rests on reproducible physics; the citation can be bounded to experimental realization and exploration. Historical review should still establish the proposed laureates’ roles among the early groups.
recusal_note: I have a longstanding collaboration with 2023 laureate Anne L’Huillier; my committee service in 2023 is undocumented. No direct connection to a proposal in this slate is apparent.
